latest_release.name: v8.2.0-BETA1
latest_release.body:
**Changelog** (https://github.com/symfony/symfony/compare/v8.1.11...v8.2.0-BETA1)

 * minor #67843 Release v8.2.0-BETA1
 * minor #67838 Require v3.8.1 of the contracts (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67841 Release v8.1.11
 * minor #67828 [DependencyInjection][FrameworkBundle] Generate config/reference.php and config/schema.json in apps without FrameworkBundle (@dtokos)
 * minor #67827 [Process] Poll with short sleeps first when waiting for a process whose pipes are closed (@mattiasgeniar)
 * minor #67817 [Messenger] Add keepalive support to the MongoDB transport (@dalerazimov)
 * bug #67819 [ObjectMapper] Don't silently skip properties that need a property accessor (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67818 [Messenger] Let a signed message whose serializer throws be replayed from the failure transport (@nicolas-grekas)
 * feature #67803 [Ldap][Security][SecurityBundle] Hash the presented password when the user is unknown, disabled or has no password (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67808 [Ldap][SecurityBundle] Fix `ldap_users_only` when a firewall uses several LDAP authenticators (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67783 [HttpClient] Record the Content-Length of the redacted response body (@akasakariko)
 * bug #67777 [JsonSchema] Don't leave empty definitions behind when generating a schema fails (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67775 [JsonSchema] Add `SchemaDocument::getDefinitionClasses()` (@DerManoMann)
 * minor #67765 [Messenger] Don't read a body or a "Sign-Algo" header that isn't a string in InteropSerializer and SigningSerializer (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67743 [Cache] Mark the options of PdoTagAwareAdapter and of the MongoDB adapters as #[\SensitiveParameter] (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67742 [Cache] Fix RedisTagAwareAdapter::prune() when an earlier command failed on the connection (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67756 [KeyManagement] Run KMIP integration tests against Eviden KMS (@X-Coder264)
 * minor #67749 [Messenger] Improve cross-platform messaging with Beanstalkd (@HypeMC)
 * bug #67755 [Workflow] Reject colliding generated service IDs (@X-Coder264)
 * minor #67687 [Security][SecurityBundle] Prepare oidc_login for a future oauth2_login (@welcoMattic)
 * minor #67737 [Cache] Fix PdoTagAwareAdapter::invalidateTags() when the tables do not exist (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67732 [KeyManagement] Update the KMIP bridge README for the new ciphers (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67729 [Cache] Fix PdoTagAwareAdapter::prune() when the items table does not exist (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67728 [BrowserKit] Revert "Preserve host-only cookies in string representations" (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67723 [Security] Do not request a re-authentication that cannot prove a recent authentication (@BenMacha)
 * bug #67697 [KeyManagement] Verify Google Cloud KMS data integrity (@X-Coder264)
 * bug #67698 [KeyManagement] Derive a separate key for each stored payload (@X-Coder264)
 * bug #67717 [Cache] Fix lazy tag table creation in PdoTagAwareAdapter (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #67704 [Cache] Fix the SQL of PdoTagAwareAdapter on MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and SQL Server (@BenMacha)
 * bug #67694 [KeyManagement] Restrict Azure algorithms and record them in ciphertexts (@X-Coder264)
 * feature #67691 [KeyManagement] Add AES-GCM-SIV support to KMIP (@X-Coder264)
 * feature #67690 [KeyManagement] Add ChaCha20-Poly1305 support to KMIP (@X-Coder264)
 * feature #67689 [KeyManagement] Add KMIP 2.1 support (@X-Coder264)
 * bug #67686 [BrowserKit] Preserve host-only cookies in string representations (@X-Coder264)
 * minor #67666 [HttpFoundation] Read the current request of RequestStack without end() (@andreybolonin)
 * bug #67667 [Security] Let `target_route` apply to impersonation URLs built for a `switch_user` path (@kbond)
 * feature #67652 [Tui] Add support for the Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) (@fabpot)
 * minor #67656 [Messenger] Process a full batch in a dispatch of its own (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67639 [ErrorHandler] Use get_exception_handler() when handling fatal errors (@andrey

detail.readme: [Symfony][1] is a **PHP framework** for web and console applications and a set of reusable **PHP components**. Symfony is used by thousands of web applications and most of the [popular PHP projects][2]. Installation ------------ * [Install Symfony][4] with Composer (see [requirements details][3]). * Symfony follows the [semantic versioning][5] strictly, publishes "Long Term Support" (LTS) versions and has a [release process][6] that is predictable and business-friendly. Sponsor ------- Symfony 8.2 is looking for [backers][27]. Help Symfony by [sponsoring][31] its development! Documentation ------------- * Read the [Getting Started guide][7] if you are new to Symfony. * Try the [Symfony Demo application][23] to learn Symfony in practice. * Discover Symfony ecosystem in detail with [Symfony The Fast Track][26]. * Master Symfony with the [Guides and Tutorials][8], the [Components docs][9] and the [Best Practices][10] reference. Community --------- * [Join the Symfony Community][11] and meet other members at the [Symfony events][12]. * [Get Symfony support][13] on GitHub Discussions, Slack, etc. * Follow us on [GitHub][14], [Twitter][15] and [Facebook][16]. * Read our [Code of Conduct][24] and meet the [CARE Team][25]. Contributing ------------ Symfony is an Open Source, community-driven project with thousands of [contributors][19]. Join them [contributing code][17] or [contributing documentation][18]. Security Issues --------------- If you discover a security vulnerability within Symfony, please follow our [disclosure procedure][20]. About Us -------- Symfony development is led by the [Symfony Core Team][22] and supported by [Symfony contributors][19].
